name: Cypress Cloud API
tagline: HTTP API for Cypress E2E test runs, specs, and results in Cypress Cloud.
description: Cypress Cloud (formerly Cypress Dashboard) exposes an HTTP API for programmatically accessing CI test run metadata, specs, and results from Cypress end-to-end browser test suites. Developers use it to query run history, integrate results into pipelines and dashboards, and automate reporting around recorded Cypress tests.

auth.details: API key authentication; exact header and signup flow need official-docs confirmation.

use_cases: list recent Cypress Cloud test runs for a project
fetch spec and test results for a specific run
